name: singlet_covariate_adjustment_gene_scaling_and_clipping
title: Gene scaling and clipping before PCA
description: Prepares the matrix that PCA and the neighbour graph consume. Method none (default) writes no matrix and leaves PCA on the unscaled values; zscore centres and scales each gene over cells with optional clipping; pearson_residuals clips residuals already written by normalization.variance_stabilizing_transform. Reads a log-normalised layer (zscore) or the residual layer, optionally var/highly_variable, and writes layers/scaled with per-gene scale parameters when scaling is on. Do not use it for batch correction, which belongs to the integration tools, or on raw counts.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

layer.description: Normalised layer under layers/ that method zscore scales; ignored by the other methods.

method.description: none leaves PCA on unscaled values (default); zscore standardises each gene; pearson_residuals clips existing residuals.

features.description: Genes to scale. highly_variable needs var/highly_variable and fails if absent; other genes are written as zero.

zero_center.description: Subtract the per-gene mean. False keeps sparse input sparse.

max_value.description: Clip magnitude after scaling; null disables clipping.

clip_mode.description: two_sided clips both tails; upper_only clips the upper tail only, as in some implementations.

ddof.description: Degrees of freedom for the per-gene standard deviation.

batch_key.description: Obs column; when set, each batch is scaled separately.

residual_layer.description: Residual layer under layers/ written by normalization.variance_stabilizing_transform.

clip.description: Symmetric residual clip: a positive number, or sqrt_n for the square root of the number of cells.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written. For method none only uns/scale_params; empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: For completed calls: method, features, n_cells, n_genes_scaled, clipped_fraction, max_value, clip_mode, zero_center, ddof, batch_key. Never matrices.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
